fields.description: Mandatory. Send this value in the X-ITGC-Token request header. Store the same value as the ITGC_GATE_TOKEN secret in the GitHub workflow. The status API is always token-protected — there is no public mode.
fields.label: Manage Change Status API Token

fields.options:
Used by the GitHub Actions merge gate. Endpoint: itgc.api.manage_change_gate.check_pr_approval. The endpoint is always token-protected (fail-closed): callers must send the token in the X-ITGC-Token header, and if no token is configured every call is rejected. There is no public mode.

Generate a token: run openssl rand -hex 32 (or python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"), paste it above, and store the same value as the GitHub repo secret ITGC_GATE_TOKEN. Full setup steps: .github/MANAGE_CHANGE_GATE.md in the itgc app.
This will disable direct access to doctypes where roles can be modified: User, Role Profile.

fields.description: User who owns access-granting responsibility (top of org). This user is automatically assigned the "ITGC Access Manager" role, which authorises granting/revoking access to other users.
fields.label: Access Manager

fields.description: Users who currently hold the "ITGC Access Manager" role (live view).
fields.label: Access Manager Role Holders

fields.description: Break-glass account. Together with System Manager holders, this is the only user who may GRANT (approve) the protected roles below. Auto-granted the 'ITGC Access Manager' role so it can act on the approval workflow. Required for Approval-Gated roles to be approvable.
fields.label: Sudo User

fields.description: FULLY RESTRICTED roles (e.g. System Manager). Hidden from the role pickers for everyone except the Sudo User / System Managers, and only they may RAISE a request granting one (enforced server-side, including via a Role Profile). Seeded with System Manager.
fields.label: Fully Restricted Roles

fields.description: APPROVAL-GATED roles (e.g. ITGC Access Manager). Anyone may REQUEST them, but only the Sudo User / a System Manager may APPROVE (grant) the request, and such requests are routed to those approvers. Seeded with ITGC Access Manager.
fields.label: Approval-Gated Roles

fields.description: When ON, public self sign-up is allowed ONLY for the email domains listed below. Admin-created users and the governed Manage Access 'New User' flow are unaffected. Fail-secure: if this is ON with no domains listed, every self sign-up is blocked.
fields.label: Restrict Self Sign-Up to Allowed Domains

fields.description: Allowed email domains for self sign-up — one per row, without the @ (e.g. solarsquare.in). Sub-domains must be listed explicitly.
fields.label: Allowed Sign-Up Domains

fields.description: Enable will disable github PR merge of specific branch without approvals
fields.label: Enable Change Management

fields.description: Email & in-app notify the department approvers (with a link) when a change is raised, and notify the requester once it is approved.
fields.label: Send Approval Notifications
